title: Buccaneers GM Jason Licht: We have no plans to trade Vita Vea

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Buccaneers GM Jason Licht: We have no plans to trade Vita Vea
sources.description: Buccaneers defensive tackle Vita Vea's agent said this week that he doesn't see Vea's contract impasse with the team "ending in anything but a trade at this point," but the team is taking a different view of things.
